lessons.title: Practice If-Else Statements
lessons.description: Finish isEven(number) so it returns true when number is divisible by 2, and false otherwise. The test checks that isEven(4) is true and isEven(7) is false.
learning_objectives: Harbor potters recount crates before dawn, and use boolean conditions and modulo operator in Java.

tests.name: test_is_even
tests.test_code: if (!Solution.isEven(4)) throw new AssertionError("4 is even"); if (Solution.isEven(7)) throw new AssertionError("7 is odd");

lessons.title: Practice Leap Year Checker
lessons.description: Implement isLeapYear(int year): a year is a leap year when it is divisible by 4 but not by 100, unless it is also divisible by 400. The tests require 2000 and 2024 to be leap years and 1900 to be a common year.
learning_objectives: Quarry potters recount crates before dawn, and apply boolean logic to leap year calculations.

tests.name: test_leap_year
tests.test_code: if (!Solution.isLeapYear(2000)) throw new AssertionError("2000 is leap"); if (Solution.isLeapYear(1900)) throw new AssertionError("1900 is not leap"); if (!Solution.isLeapYear(2024)) throw new AssertionError("2024 is leap");
